text: Figure 2.15: Define Software Component Safety Information Activity Develop an Atomic Software Component Package AUTOSAR Root::M2::Methodology::Methodology Use Cases::Software Component::Develop Atomic SWC Brief Description Description This is the generic pattern valid for several kinds of Atomic Software Components. The first step is to create design, including the runnables, events, interrunnable variables, etc. Once this is complete, the contract header files can be created and the software component can be implemented. Note that the method of implementation, quality , testing, etc. are beyond the scope of this capability pattern. After the component is implemented and successfully compiled, its resources are measured and stored as part of the software component for further usage by downstream processes. The pattern also includes the optional tasks of creating a timing model, defining safety relevant information, binding prebuild-variants and evaluating variants, all in the scope of the Atomic Software Component. Note that the sequence of these optional tasks within the capability pattern is only one possible example.
